resources.string: Backup

An encrypted .labterm file with your vaults: hosts, groups, identities, keys, certificates, snippets, forwarding rules, known hosts and OpenID providers. It works offline, without an account, and restores on Android, desktop and Labterm Web.

Step %1$d of %2$d
This guide moves your vaults to another Labterm server, for example from Termoso Cloud to your own: back up, sign out, sign in or create an account on the new server, restore.
Moves with you
Hosts, groups, identities, keys, certificates, snippets, forwarding rules, known hosts, OpenID providers and settings in your vaults, team vaults included
Set up again on the new server
Teams, members and access rules (team vaults are restored into your personal vault)
Connection history and session recordings
Signed-in devices: sign in on each of them again
SSH ID handle and published keys
Two-factor sign-in and security keys of the account
Team vaults whose policy forbids export
First, a backup of every vault on this phone. Choose a password for the file; you need it only if the restore has to start over.
The backup is saved and checked. Now sign out of %s. Synced vaults are removed from this phone; your account and data there stay until you delete them.
Sign out of %s
Sign in to the new server, or create an account there. Enter its address on the sign-in screen. The guide continues when you are signed in.
Sign in to the new server
You are signed in to the same server as before. Sign out and pick the new server if that was not intended.
The backup is no longer open (the app was restarted). Enter its password and pick the file you saved.
Open backup file…
Signed in to %s. Choose where each vault of the backup goes.
Your vaults are on the new server and sync from there.
Your account on %s still exists. Delete it there once you no longer need it.
